title: 12 Week Women’s Bikini Body Program
author: Luke N.
desc:
This program isn’t just about looking good in a bikini—it’s about feeling unstoppable in your own skin. It’s about stepping onto the beach with confidence, knowing you’ve put in the work, and embracing a body that reflects your strength, discipline, and dedication.

We designed this program for women who are ready to push past their limits, build lean muscle, and burn stubborn fat—all while celebrating their power, femininity, and resilience. Every rep, every drop of sweat, and every small victory will bring you closer to the strongest, most sculpted version of yourself.

This isn’t just a fitness journey. It’s a transformation—inside and out. Are you ready to commit to YOU? Let’s make this summer your strongest yet.

ex.note:
First 2 sets are warm up sets. 

On your light warm up and first working set, perform a 8-10 second hold at the top at the end of each rep

First set, very light weights again. 

Make sure your back is straight and knees are slight bent. Remember it’s not a normal deadlifts, it’s a hinge at the hips. 

Bum to the back of the room!!

Keep toes pointing up the whole time!!

Slow and controlled on the way back back up

Mainly driving through your heels and slightly leaning over knees and toes.

Keep chest over knees and toes the whole time 

Last set do 3x Drop set (8 with both KBs, 8 with 1 KB, 8 with no KB

Keep facing the floor when bringing body up right.

Don’t fully straighten out your back and this will target lower back more!!

Keep your back as horizontal as possible!!

Really focus on engaging your last before pulling up and focus on bringing elbows to hips. 

Keep chest up tall whole time

As many reps as possible (failure)

Feet shoulder width apart, legs stay straight, NO LEG DRIVE

Hands placed in front rack position, shoulder width apart

Head directly under bar when over head

ss.note: Can be done either push ups on your knees, normal push ups off your knees or hand release push ups (chest to floor, hands off floor, then pushing back up to starting position)

ex.note:
Use upper back handle (horizontal) 

Keep chest up tall the whole time, try not to round top of back

Control the weight back SLOWLY

ss.note:
TEMPO WORK (3 secs on the way back up)

Mainly pull through pinky fingers when pulling bar down

Keep chest tall the whole time during the movement, don’t round top of back

Drop set last set if needs

Control weight down to start position as much as possible!!

Keep elbows higher than shoulders and wrists

Keep elbows pinned against your side, the don’t move at all!!

Push through palm/pinky’s and split the rope at the bottom

Fully extend arms when pushing down

This can be done with a barbell, dumbbells or if you can get 2 cables then can also be done on cables as well. 

Keep elbows pinned by your side. Elbows don’t move at all!!

Keep wrists locked!!

ex.note:
Feet placed slightly lower on the board. This will taget quads more than glutes and hamstrings

Push through your mid foot, not so much your heels!!

Knees come as close to chest as possible!!

Last 2 sets are 8 reps then 8 second hold (or till failure)!!!

TEMPO WORK (3 secs on the way down)

Keep toes facing up the whole time 

Control weight back down

Step out in front and to the side slightly to keep balance 

Push through heels to get back up, stepping in front

Casual step out away from bench/box

Ankle should roll over the edge of bench/box

Keep chest up tall when lowering

Push through mid foot on the way back up 

8,8,8 dropset with KB is optional!

EACH SET IS A DROP SET IN WEIGHT!!

DROP THE WEIGHT 10kg from what weight you was on before the dropset

As quick as you can pushing legs in together, then slowly releasing legs back to start position

Really focus on engaging your last before pulling up and focus on bringing elbows to hips. 

Keep chest up tall whole time

As many reps as possible (failure)

ss.note:
Dumbbells start at eye level, bring down to nipple line

Bring dumbbells down SLOWLY and elbows are at 45° angle 

Slight lower back arch when pressing dumbbells up

Pushups are super set after this!!
These can be done on your knees, normally off your knees or hand release push ups (chest to floor, hands off the floor, push up back up to starting position)

ex.note:
Dumbbells on knees to start, then kicking them up to start above head.

Bring dumbbells down slowly till your elbows are at 90° or very slightly below

Push back up to start position quickly

Keep chest tall and don’t swing forwards and backwards with weight!!!!

Keep core tight

Focus on just rowing your elbows back behind you, keep elbows low when doing this!!

FOCUS ON DRIVING WITH YOUR ELBOWS!!!

Drive elbows back and slightly raise your hands up (almost as if you’re flexing your biceps) this will engage rear delts more

Slowly bring weight back to start
